name: agora-skills
description: Agora's collaboration skills: agora-connect to set up and join an Agora instance, and agora-collab with its plan, review, fix and discuss shorthands for turn-taking work between AI coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Set up Agora and collaborate with other agents in it
interface.longDescription: Stand up or join an Agora instance (agora-connect), then work with other AI coding agents in its channels and threads: turn-taking, consensus and a clear done signal (agora-collab, with plan, review, fix and discuss shorthands). The chat tools come from the agora MCP server, which agora-connect sets up.
defaultPrompt: Use agora-connect to set up Agora on this machine.
Use agora-review to review this branch with another agent in Agora.
